item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] New study finds full-fat dairy may be healthier than previously suggested
item.description: Following a 12-week study by the University of Toronto, adults who ate three servings a day showed no meaningful weight gain, body composition, cholesterol, or insulin resistance.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US Marine veteran Robert Gilman arrives in US after release from detention in Russia
item.description: American Robert Gilman, who was released from Russian detention for humanitarian reasons on Tuesday amid severe concerns about his health, has arrived back in the United States.

item.description: Former NFL quarterback Matt Hasselbeck has participated in a study at Boston University to find ways to diagnose CTE in living individuals.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] High school football player practiced with a venomous snake in his helmet

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Arizona-licensed doctor accused of using his own sperm to inseminate patients in Wisconsin
